// note: knowless ships hand-written .js + JSDoc. TYPES TOOLCHAIN ONLY (no app build step): `npm run build:types` emits .d.ts from the JSDoc into ./types (git-ignored, built on publish via prepublishOnly), `npm run typecheck` is the CI gate. `strict` is off because the sources are hand-written JS, not TS; `strictNullChecks` is on — it keeps the genuine null-safety value without the noImplicitAny annotation noise (matches the bareagent/bareguard suite standard, see LIBRARY_CONVENTIONS.md).
